summary: Comprehensive testing completed for updated Prayer Times PWA with Diyanet API integration, dark mode default, city change fixes, and Ramadan calendar improvements. All major features working correctly with verified API integration and proper interval management.

console_warnings.issue: React hydration errors - HTML structure warnings with span elements inside table elements (th, tr, td, tbody)
console_warnings.impact: No functional impact, but creates multiple console warnings in React DevTools

✅ Theme toggle correctly switches between light/dark and saves to localStorage
✅ Diyanet API (ezanvakti.emushaf.net) returns valid prayer times successfully
✅ All 6 prayer times display correctly with Turkish names (İmsak, Güneş, Öğle, İkindi, Akşam, Yatsı)
✅ City change immediately updates Iftar time (Erzincan 18:09 → Istanbul 18:49 → Erzincan 18:09)
✅ Countdown timer continues correctly after city change (04:56:14 → different values)
✅ No duplicate countdown intervals - proper useRef interval management verified
✅ Ramadan progress bar shows correct day and percentage (Ramazan'ın 1. günü — %3)
✅ Ramadan schedule modal opens with 28 rows of data
✅ Ramadan modal includes day number column starting from 1
✅ Ramadan schedule shows correct dates starting from 19.02.2026 (verified in API)
✅ URL parameter ?city=ankara changes city on load correctly
✅ LocalStorage persists city selection with proper JSON format
✅ Akşam (Iftar) prayer card properly highlighted with special styling
✅ Footer shows correct Diyanet attribution text
✅ No critical console errors - app functions smoothly
action_item_for_main_agent: Consider fixing React hydration warnings in the Ramadan schedule modal table structure - conditional rendering is creating span wrappers inside table elements. This is a low priority issue that doesn't affect functionality but generates console warnings.
